control.name: CONTROL — disarm the decision-label gate (a needs-decision item becomes closeable)

mutations.name: a WORKER token falls through to the reviewer half (the single-actor close, restated as a mutation)
a worker's --dispute is no longer refused (the worker disputes instead of proposing)
the same actor may propose AND confirm (the two-role property collapses to one role)
a reviewer may confirm with NO standing proposal (the reviewer originates the supersession)
the dispute posts its reason but never applies needs-decision (the item stays closeable)
mutations.old: if err := addLabel(c.repo, n, it, deskkit.LabelSpec{Name: labelNeedsDecision}); err != nil {
mutations.new: if err := addLabel(c.repo, n, it, deskkit.LabelSpec{Name: "not-applied"}); err != nil {

mutations.name: the proposal posts its comment but never applies superseded? (invisible to the queue and the sweep)
an UNREADABLE token identity is rounded up to the reviewer role (could-not-check becomes a grant)
a roster binding both roles to ONE App is accepted (the lane enforces nothing and says so to no one)
a fenced documentation example is read as a live proposal
the back-reference on the target is dropped (the record reads in one direction only)
a closed-unmerged target satisfies the confirm (work that never landed supersedes live work)
the close is routed by NUMBER again (a change is closed as the issue sharing its number)
mutations.old: if err := fg.CloseIssueTyped(fr, n, kind, reason); err != nil {
mutations.new: if err := fg.CloseIssue(fr, n, reason); err != nil {

mutations.name: the proposal thread is read UNTYPED again (an issue reads another object's notes)
a stated kind no longer selects the read (the typed form resolves nothing)
a sigil and a kind flag that disagree are resolved in favour of the flag
mutations.old: kind, kerr := deskkit.ResolveStatedKind("the item number", ref, flagKind)
